title: ‘Freak Out’ Indicator Soars to Record With War Sparking Trader Anxiety
title_zh: “惊慌”指标飙升至创纪录水平，战争引发交易者焦虑
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Investors wary of being wrong-footed by twists and turns in the Iran war are trading stocks at a record intensity, one market measure shows.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——一项市场指标显示，投资者正以创纪录的强度进行股票交易，以免因伊朗战争的曲折而措手不及。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures surge on news of a two-week ceasefire
title_zh: 今日股市：受两周停火消息影响，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货大幅上涨
summary: The news of a potential ceasefire between the US and Iran has seen stock futures pop after-hours.
summary_zh: 美国和伊朗之间可能停火的消息导致股指期货盘后上涨。

title: Why the Iran war is hitting everyday investors especially hard
title_zh: 为什么伊朗战争对普通投资者的打击尤其严重
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma joins the show to explain how the war in Iran is especially impacting investors who have put more of their wealth into the stock market in recent years.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级记者布鲁克·迪帕尔玛 (Brooke DiPalma) 加入节目，解释伊朗战争如何特别影响近年来将更多财富投入股市的投资者。
